parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The two methods — `recordRequestSentIncrementsCount` (line 38) and `recordSongAddedToLibraryIncrementsCount` (line 54) — are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.75) because they test analogous increment-counting behaviour on different user actions, which is intentional: each test exercises a distinct code path (`recordRequestSent` vs `recordSongAddedToLibrary`) and must remain independent to preserve test isolation and failure locality. Collapsing them into a shared helper would obscure which action is under test and reduce diagnostic clarity on failure.
